subtype: Approach: introducing himself and asking someone to play [Action]

subtype: Approach: introducing himself and asking someone to play [Action]

I just moved here from Gdańsk. Can I play?" A boy with a gap in his teeth, Nour, shrugged. "We need a goalkeeper. Nobody wants to be goalkeeper." "I'll be goalkeeper." subtype: Approach: staying alone and waiting for others to come [Pitfall]
passage:
Class teacher's note, Friday, Class 4B
Farida joined us three weeks ago. Every lunch break she sits on the far bench by the water cooler with her tiffin on her knees, looking at the other children now and then. She does not call to anyone. Today I asked Swati why nobody sits with her. Swati said, "She likes being alone, ma'am. She never talks." I think Farida is waiting to be asked, and the others think she wants to be left alone, so each side is waiting. This week she has begun eating less and looking at the floor more. On Monday I will seat her with Swati's table for a group project and tell her parents what I have seen.

qa.q: Where does Farida sit every lunch break?
qa.a: She sits on the far bench by the water cooler.

Dear diary, day eleven at the new school. I sat on the bench near the swings again at lunch. I brought the good aloo sandwich so if someone came I could share it. Nobody came. Sharmila's group walked past and one of them said, "Leave her, she likes her own company." I don't! I wanted to shout it. But I just looked at my sandwich. Mummy asked how school was and I said fine. It's not fine. It's like being a glass window. Everyone sees me and nobody thinks to come in. Maybe tomorrow I will sit at the end of Sharmila's table. Maybe. My stomach goes funny just writing that.

subtype: Approach: using a shared interest to start talking [Thinking]

That's something I can talk about without messing up." At the break he leaned forward. "That's a cover drive, right? The front foot is perfect." Sarita turned around, surprised. "You play?" subtype: Approach: using a shared interest to start talking [Thinking]

subtype: Approach: asking the teacher to pair him with a buddy [Action]

Hafsa has joined us from Hyderabad. At lunch, the girls' table filled up and Hafsa ate alone, still talking about her old school to nobody in particular.
